newsitem.title: USA: NL Industries sees lower results from Kronos.
newsitem.headline: NL Industries sees lower results from Kronos.

text.p: NL Industries Inc said on Thursday it expected operating income at its Kronos operations to be lower than in 1996, because it expected lower average titanium dioxide prices in 1997.
But the company said it expected its operating margins to improve in the second quarter of 1997, as recently-announced titanium dioxide price increases took effect.
Operating income of Kronos's titanium dioxide business was $71.6 million, an $89.6 million decrease compared to 1995 on a five percent decrease in net sales, the company said.

President and Chief Executive Officer J. Landis Martin said: "Demand for titanium dioxide in 1996 increased over 1995 and we expect demand to remain strong in 1997. We believe continued growth in demand should result in significant improvement in average selling prices over the longer term."
